name: Predictive Accel Boost
author: sunnypilot
description: Port of sunnypilot predictive accel boost (#2089): while engaged with openpilot longitudinal, adds up to 0.4/0.25/0.1 m/s^2 (aggressive/standard/relaxed) to the model's acceleration when the model predicts a gas press and no brake press, building at 0.2 m/s^3. No boost when the model wants to stop, in curves (fades out 1.5-2.5 m/s^2 lateral) or below 1 m/s. The planner still takes the lowest of lead following, cruise and model, so it never passes a lead car or the set speed. Replaces openpilot's gas-override boost while on. On by default, as upstream.
